zh: 新增「我的」页：底部第五个标签从「设置」换成「我的」，设置收进这一页里的一行，点进去单独一屏。页面顶上是你自己——头像取邮箱首字母，下面跟着昵称和邮箱，没登录就只是应用名。中间三个数字是今日复习、连续天数、总词数，用衬线字体排，等分三列、中间不画分隔线。再往下是从表格或备份批量导入、以及进入设置两行；然后一张告诉你电脑上也有 Lexumo 的卡片；最后一行写着版本号。词库页顶部重新排过：当前这本固定在左边成一个下拉胶囊，其余同语言的词本在一条带子里横向滚动，右边的加号不动。这样无论有多少本词本都只占一行，不会再折行把词条区挤掉；切换跨语言的词本仍然点带子上的标签。新建词库时的「快速开始」推荐现在只在你选的是一门有现成词库的语言时才出现——建英语词库不会再推荐五十音。
en: A new Me page: the fifth tab is now Me instead of Settings, and settings moved inside it as a row that opens its own screen. The page starts with you — the avatar takes the first letter of your email, with the name and address beside it, or just the app name when you are signed out. Then three figures for today's reviews, the streak and the total word count, set in the serif face, evenly spaced across three columns with no rules between them. Below that are the two bulk actions, import from a spreadsheet or a backup, and settings; then a card pointing at the desktop build; and the build number on the last line. The top of the word library was rebuilt too: the wordbook you are in now sits on the left as a fixed dropdown capsule, the rest of the wordbooks in that language scroll sideways in a single strip, and the plus on the right stays put. However many wordbooks you keep, it is one row — it can no longer wrap and eat a row from the word list, and you still switch languages by tapping a tab in the strip. The Quick start suggestions when creating a wordbook now only appear for a language that has a ready-made deck, so making an English wordbook no longer offers the kana decks.
